annotations.title: Car Finance: PCP, HP, Leasing or Cash

description: The same car over the same term, compared as PCP (keeping it or handing it back), hire purchase, leasing and cash: the monthly payment, the total each costs, the interest in it, and what is owned at the end. Only the ways given are shown. Use for 'PCP or HP on a £25k car', 'is leasing cheaper than buying'.

balloon.description: The PCP's final payment (the guaranteed future value) - paid at the end to keep the car, less than the price less the deposit.

cashRatePct.description: The savings rate the cash could earn instead, as an AER. Defaults to 0, which leaves it out.

deposit.description: Paid up front on a PCP or hire purchase deal, less than the price. Defaults to 0.

hpAprPct.description: The hire purchase APR, e.g. 9.9. Give it to see hire purchase.

leaseEndFees.description: What a lease would charge at the end - extra miles, damage, collection. Defaults to 0.

leaseInitial.description: A lease's initial rental, paid up front - often several months' rentals. Defaults to 0.

leaseMonthly.description: A lease's monthly rental. Give it to see leasing.

pcpAprPct.description: The PCP's APR, e.g. 9.9. Give it with balloon to see a PCP.

termMonths.description: The term in whole months, 1 to 120 - the same for every way of paying.
